latest_release.name: v0.12.0 — Reconstruction cases, research and clearer browsing
latest_release.body:
Source / 固定来源：[7e648ad](https://github.com/reacher-z/Awesome-REA/tree/7e648adca7aae6973cb23077ccd1739959c3e53f)

Snapshot / 快照：**170 resources / 项资源 · 40 papers / 篇论文 · 2,846 browsable repositories / 个可浏览仓库**

3 papers appear in both the catalog and bibliography; counts are not additive. / 其中 3 篇论文同时收录于精选目录与书目，数量不可直接相加。

**[Download ZIP / 下载 ZIP](https://github.com/reacher-z/Awesome-REA/releases/download/v0.12.0/awesomerea-v0.12.0-data.zip)** · [BibTeX](https://github.com/reacher-z/Awesome-REA/releases/download/v0.12.0/papers.bib) · [Checksums / 校验和](https://github.com/reacher-z/Awesome-REA/releases/download/v0.12.0/SHA256SUMS.txt)

## English

Compact browsing now keeps full descriptions readable, with optional cards, clearer details, stronger contrast and more usable mobile filters. The bilingual paper directory adds title, summary, author and identifier search, plus target, year and publication-status filters. READMEs gain counted Contents and expandable paper details.

Since v0.11, the catalog broadens game, app and device-protocol cases, alongside tools and research. Additions include sm64, Unleashed Recompiled, OpenMW, REDRIVER2 and Code World Models. Existing entries also receive metadata, classification, source and translation corrections.

The coverage ledger records **512 occurrences / 510 inventory units**, with pending, partial and full mappings kept distinct. These are not unique verified-project counts. The complete index retains 3,000 successful README reads and 44 failed attempts; 154 entries are excluded from browsing. Source review does not establish runtime reproduction.

## 简体中文

紧凑列表默认保留完整简介，同时提供可选卡片、更清楚的详情、更强对比和更易用的移动筛选。双语论文目录支持标题、简介、作者和标识符搜索，以及目标、年份和发表状态筛选；README 增加带数量的目录与可展开论文详情。

相较 v0.11，合集扩展游戏、应用和设备协议案例，以及工具与研究，包括 sm64、Unleashed Recompiled、OpenMW、REDRIVER2 和 Code World Models。既有条目的元数据、分类、来源和译文也有修订，并非全部保持原样。

覆盖记录区分出现项、清单单元和待审／部分／完整映射，不将它们称为独立且已核验的项目数。核查来源不等于运行复现。

## Downloads / 下载

[ZIP](https://github.com/reacher-z/Awesome-REA/releases/download/v0.12.0/awesomerea-v0.12.0-data.zip), [catalog JSON](https://github.com/reacher-z/Awesome-REA/releases/download/v0.12.0/catalog.json), [paper JSON](https://github.com/reacher-z/Awesome-REA/releases/download/v0.12.0/papers.json), [source JSON](https://github.com/reacher-z/Awesome-REA/releases/download/v0.12.0/source-index.json), [BibTeX](https://github.com/reacher-z/Awesome-REA/releases/download/v0.12.0/papers.bib), [scope decisions](https://github.com/reacher-z/Awesome-REA/releases/download/v0.12.0/scope-exclusions.json), [case coverage](https://github.com/reacher-z/Awesome-REA/releases/download/v0.12.0/case-coverage.json), [manifest](https://github.com/reacher-z/Awesome-REA/releases/download/v0.12.0/manifest.json) and [checksums](https://github.com/reacher-z/Awesome-REA/releases/download/v0.12.0/SHA256SUMS.txt) provide a source-pinned snapshot. Verify hashes against the same release; later website changes are separate.

ZIP、目录／论文／来源 JSON、BibTeX、范围决定、案例台账、清单和校验和均对应固定提交。请使用同一发行版核对哈希；网站后续变化另计。

A collection of tools, case studies and research for websites, games, apps, native binaries, firmware and communication protocols. **English** · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) **[Search the website](https://awesomerea.org/)** · **[Browse resources](https://awesomerea.org/resources/)** · **[Cases](https://awesomerea.org/cases/)** · **[Papers](https://awesomerea.org/papers/)** · **[API](https://awesomerea.org/api/)** · **[Suggest a resource](https://github.com/reacher-z/Awesome-REA/issues/new?template=resource.yml)** · **[Contributing](#contributing)** ![resources: 5,191](https://img.shields.io/badge/resources-5%2C191-6B5159?style=flat-square&labelColor=2B2F3A) ![cases: 4,025](https://img.shields.io/badge/cases-4%2C025-6B5159?style=flat-square&labelColor=2B2F3A) ![papers: 442](https://img.shields.io/badge/papers-442-6B5159?style=flat-square&labelColor=2B2F3A) [![last discovery scan](https://img.shields.io/endpoint?url=https%3A%2F%2Fraw.githubusercontent.com%2Freacher-z%2FAwesome-REA%2Fstatus%2Fscan-status.json&label=last%20discovery%20scan&style=flat-square)](data/discoveries/README.md) ![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-5E6472?style=flat-square&labelColor=2B2F3A) If this collection is useful, a [star on GitHub](https://github.com/reacher-z/Awesome-REA) helps others find it. [Review method](https://awesomerea.org/about/) Featured benchmarks: | Website reconstruction | Browser agents | | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | |
Can AI agents rebuild websites through browser exploration?
★ Star on GitHub |
Open-source benchmark for browser AI agents on daily tasks.
★ Star on GitHub | **Featured:** [Awesome Computer-Use Agents](https://github.com/reacher-z/Awesome-CUA) — a source-backed catalog of papers, models, datasets, benchmarks and tools for agents that use computers. ## Contents 5,191 curated resources (4,025 cases) · 442 papers · 3,309 indexed repositories · latest source review 2026-11-09. - [Find by task](#find-by-task) - [Use the data](#use-the-data) - [Resources](#resources) (5,188) - [Website](#website) (128) — Tools and cases for inspecting, deobfuscating and rebuilding websites - [Game](#game) (2,976) — Decompilations, recompilations, ports, engine reimplementations, analysis tools and cases - [App](#app) (370) — Analysis tools and cases for Android, .NET, JVM and Electron apps - [Native Binary](#native-binary) (502) — Disassemblers, decompilers, debuggers, binary libraries, diffing tools and native cases - [Firmware and Hardware](#firmware-and-hardware) (260) — Firmware extraction and analysis tools, plus hardware and device-image cases - [Protocol](#protocol) (720) — Tools and cases for wire formats, device protocols and packet captures - [Agents and MCP](#agents-and-mcp) (91) — Official REA material, MCP servers, integrations and agent workflows, labelled by REA relationship - [Related Collections](#related-collections) (33) — Other curated lists on reverse engineering and related security topics - [References and Learning](#references-and-learning) (108) — Documentation, investigation guides, labs and learning resources - [Papers](#papers) (442) — Research bibliography, kept in generated paper lists - [Most recent papers](#most-recent-papers) (10) - [Full Repository Index](#full-repository-index) (3,309) — Public repositories found by README scans; unreviewed - [About](#about) - [Star History](#star-history) **For agents:** [Repository instructions](AGENTS.md) · [How to contribute and submit a PR](docs/agent-contributing.md) · [Contribution forms](https://awesomerea.org/contribute/) ## Find by task | Task | Where to look | | ---------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Inspect a website or app interface | [Website resources](https://awesomerea.org/resources/#heading-website) · [App resources](https://awesomerea.org/resources/#heading-app) | | Rebuild a game or check matching code | [Game resources](https://awesomerea.org/resources/#heading-game) · [Game cases](https://awesomerea.org/cases/#cases-game) | | Analyze compiled code or recover symbols | [Native binary resources](https://awesomerea.org/resources/#heading-native-binary) · [Agents and MCP](https://awesomerea.org/resources/#heading-agents-and-mcp) | | Investigate firmware or device protocols | [Firmware resources](https://awesomerea.org/resources/#heading-firmware) · [Protocol resources](https://awesomerea.org/resources/#heading-protocol) | | Compare methods and evaluation evidence | [Survey comparisons](https://awesomerea.org/survey/#comparative-studies) | ## Use the data Use these public files and pages to read the catalog, follow changes, or work with its structured data. - [llms.txt](https://awesomerea.org/llms.txt) - Machine-readable site map for language models. - [llms-full.txt](https://awesomerea.org/llms-full.txt) - Curated entries in one Markdown text. - [API index](https://awesomerea.org/api/v1/index.json) - Static JSON and CSV exports of resources, papers and categories, plus unreviewed candidates. - [catalog.json](https://awesomerea.org/catalog.json) - Curated catalog in one JSON file. - [JSON Feed](https://awesomerea.org/feed.json) - New and changed entries in JSON Feed format. - [Hugging Face dataset](https://huggingface.co/datasets/TIGER-Lab/AwesomeREA) - Parquet and JSONL exports for resources, papers, cases and discovery records. - [Catalog format](https://github.com/reacher-z/Awesome-REA/blob/main/data/README.md) - Fields, vocabulary and review rules for every record. ## Resources Names link to original sources. Each line gives the opening sentence of the description, then the type and relationship; “Full entry” opens the complete description, prerequisites, limitations and review sources. Each resource appears once under its main purpose. Cases reuse these entries; papers are listed separately. REA labels refer to the separate upstream CLI and MCP project, described under About. **Tags:** Official REA: published by the REA project · Community REA: third-party REA work · REA maintainer: an REA maintainer's list · Independent MCP, Independent agent, Independent reconstruction: no established REA connection · Mixed workflow: REA plus other tools, per the author · Android, .NET, JVM, WebAssembly: platform · Library: code library · type only: foundation tool or learning resource. ### Website **76 case studies**. The 10 newest are below. [Full case list](docs/cases.md#website). #### Case studies - [**canopy-dotmatrix: reconstructing davidluft.com's dot-matrix window**](https://github.com/isjiajia01/canopy-dotmatrix) - Reconstructs the dot-matrix window on davidluft.com from its public JavaScript bundle and scene payloads. Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/canopy-dotmatrix-case/) - [**Dih Pinterest: reconstructing a Pinterest search site's page and data flow**](https://github.com/Ikyletwar/dih-pinterest-replica) - Dih Pinterest reconstructs the search interface and data flow of searchpinterest.vercel.app as a static web app with an optional Vercel proxy. Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/dih-pinterest-case/) - [**Drama Live: analysing its Android and web clients and rebuilding an API client**](https://github.com/barhomus10/dramalive-analysis) - Drama Live analysis documents the Android APK and web PWA of the IPTV player, including their component stacks, endpoint maps and content-source flows. Case study · Independent reconstruction · Also: App · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/dramalive-analysis-case/) - [**edgestash: reconstructing Vercel Blob and Upstash Redis API behavior**](https://github.com/devtechedge/edgestash) - edgestash implements a self-hosted server for the Vercel Blob and Upstash Redis REST APIs, allowing their published SDKs to use a different endpoint. Case study · Mixed workflow · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/edgestash-case/) - [**github-websocket-pipelines-api: probing GitHub Actions live-log messages**](https://github.com/Hacksore/github-websocket-pipeline-api) - github-websocket-pipelines-api probes GitHub Actions' undocumented live-log WebSocket interface. Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/inception-chat-extraction-case/) - [**LoreMaps: a static rewrite of a fantasy-map atlas**](https://github.com/loremaps/loremaps) - A static Astro atlas rewritten from the project’s earlier ASP.NET MVC site.
